title: University of El Segundo Coffee Atlas — first edition source set

center.name: El Segundo City Hall
center.coordinateMethod: Census address interpolation confirmed by parent; approximate address point, not rooftop precision

distanceMethod: WGS84 ellipsoid Vincenty inverse from the shared City Hall point, using approximate Census street-address interpolation or merchant-linked directions destination points as specified in each record; 1 mile = 1609.344 meters.
limitations: A selected first edition, not a census of coffee businesses within the radius.
Official public pages were reviewed on 2026-10-03; website observations may be cached or differ from current counter service.
Assortment examples are partial. Brand online catalogs do not establish local café stock or real-time availability.

Coordinates are approximate public source address points: Census street-address interpolation or merchant-linked directions destinations as documented per record. They do not verify entrances, parking, or accessible routes.
Physical accessibility, municipal business licenses, and facility health inspection outcomes were not independently verified.
No company sales, revenue, profit, endorsements, or private customer data are inferred.
